sound_areas.why_sound: The ledger is append-only (UPDATE and DELETE revoked), balanced per currency through a deferred trigger, recomputed nightly against the projection, and payouts are frozen on a discrepancy. The FR-10 acceptance test checks all of this, so FR-10 and P5 are met and verifiable.
